title: Look up the first matching Sheets row

conversation.text: Manual workflow: look up SKU B-200 in my Google Sheet (spreadsheet ID 1ZyXwVuTsRqPoNmLkJiHgFeDcBa9876543210), tab 'Stock', and POST only the FIRST matching row's Price to https://shop.example.com/api/price as JSON field price. There can be several rows for the same SKU; I only want one POST.

description: Google Sheets read has a version-gated 'first match only' option (returnAllMatches before 4.5, returnFirstMatch from 4.5). Grades that only the first matching row flows downstream.

executionScenarios.name: only-first-match-posted
executionScenarios.description: Google Sheets read has a version-gated 'first match only' option (returnAllMatches before 4.
executionScenarios.dataSetup: The 'Stock' tab has header row SKU | Price | Warehouse and data rows: A-100 | 9.50 | Berlin, B-200 | 19.99 | Berlin, B-200 | 24.99 | Lisbon, C-300 | 5.00 | Berlin. Answer Google Sheets API reads (GET .../values/Stock...) with exactly those values. The price endpoint returns 200 { "ok": true }.
executionScenarios.successCriteria: Exactly one POST reaches https://shop.example.com/api/price, with price 19.99 (number or string '19.99'). Two POSTs, a POST with 24.99, or a POST with an empty price FAILS.

outcomeExpectations: The Google Sheets read filters on SKU = B-200 and is configured to return only the first match, so a single item reaches the POST.
